title: Promotion To Equivalent Civil Post Doesn't Automatically Confer Substantive Military Rank: Delhi HC
description: A Division Bench of the Delhi High Court comprising Justice Anil Kshetarpal and Justice Amit Mahajan held that the substantive military rank of Brigadier or Major General is not automatically conferred upon holding an equivalent civil post; it remains subject to satisfaction of Army promotion norms, including medical eligibility.
